box.title: Longwood vs Ward Melville
box.highlights: Ward Melville 35, Longwood 7: Joe Benedetto had nine carries for 84 yards and a touchdown and caught a 74 yard touchdown to lead host Ward Melville in Suffolk I. Hudson Philbrick had three completions for 140 yards and two touchdowns. Joe Karpowicz had a 22-yard touchdown reception and JJ Alcindor had a 44-yard reception. Jesse Spronck had an interception. Kyon Sarwari had 105 rushing yards and a touchdown for Longwood.

box.title: Ward Melville vs Bay Shore
box.highlights: Ward Melville 49, Bay Shore 14: Ward Melville middle linebacker Liam Cronin opened the scoring by blocking the punt on Bay Shore's first possession, recovering the ball, and scoring a 4-yard touchdown to set the tone as Ward Melville defeated host Bay Shore in Suffolk I. Hudson Philbrick had four passing touchdowns, including two touchdowns to Angelo Sorbera. Sorbera also had a key block to spring Joey Benedetto's 70-yard touchdown run in the second quarter for Ward Melville (2-0). Ethan Jargo was 7 of 7 on PATs. Bay Shore is 0-2.

box.title: Ward Melville vs Whitman
box.highlights: Ward Melville 35, Whitman 7: Angelo Sorbera returned the opening kickoff 85 yards for a touchdown in Ward Melville's 35-7 road win over Whitman in Suffolk I Friday night. Hudson Philbrick connected with Jesse Spronck for a 54-yard TD on the Patriots' first offensive possession. Liam Cronin led the defense with 10 tackles. Joe Benedetto rushed nine times for 56 yards and two scores. Ethan Jargo converted all five of his PAT attempts for Ward Melville (3-0). Shamel Greene ran for an 8-yard TD for Whitman (1-2).

box.title: Sachem North vs Ward Melville
box.highlights: Ward Melville 43, Sachem North 13: Hudson Philbrick completed all but two of his 12 passing attempts for 215 yards and two touchdowns for Ward Melville in its home win in Suffolk I. Victor Bergamaschi led the defense with two sacks and two tackles for loss. Joe Benedetto rushed 18 times for 159 yards and three scores for Ward Melville (4-0). Luke LaRocca threw a 28-yard TD pass to Lucas Bouchard for Sachem North (2-2). Henry Sarro added a rushing TD.

box.title: Central Islip vs Ward Melville
box.highlights: Ward Melville 56, Central Islip 0: Tony Gorsky had 10 carries for 157 yards a touchdown to lead host Ward Melville () in Suffolk I. Gorsky was one of seven Patriots to score a TD. Joe Benedetto ran for two touchdowns and Hudson Philbrick ran for a score and threw a 44-yard TD pass to Jesse Spronck. Angelo Sorbera, Christian Hubbard and LJ DePaul each added a TD run. Joey Karpowicz had two interceptions. Central Islip is 2-3.

box.title: Ward Melville vs Floyd
box.highlights: Floyd 28, Ward Melville 21: Ja'Quan Thomas ran for 201 yards and four touchdowns on 30 carries to keep the host Floyd undefeated (6-0) in Suffolk I. Evan Commodore picked up a third quarter INT and Aisays Wallace forced a fumble in the fourth quarter.

box.title: Ward Melville vs Brentwood
box.highlights: Ward Melville 42, Brentwood 20: Hudson Philbrick completed 12 of 14 passes for 183 yards and 4 TDs to lead visiting Ward Melville (6-1) in Suffolk I. Joe Benedetto rushed 19 times for 126 yards and 2 TDs, and added a TD reception. Cris Peralta, Julius Herrera and Evan Johnson each had a TD for Brentwood (3-4).

box.title: Sachem East vs Ward Melville
box.highlights: Ward Melville 35, Sachem East 0: Anthony Fardellone had seven tackles to lead host Ward Melville (7-1) in Suffolk I. Joe Karpowicz ran for a 6-yard touchdown and caught a 26-yard score from Hudson Philbrick, who added a 40-yard TD pass to Alcindor. Joe Benedetto ran for 178 yards and a touchdown. Sachem East is 3-5.

box.title: Brentwood vs Ward Melville
box.highlights: Ward Melville 56, Brentwood 27: After a 14-13 1st quarter, Ward Melville scored 35 unanswered points. Hudson Philbrick completed 8 of 10 passes for 163 yards and 2 TDs, and added 95 yards on 7 carries and 3 TDs on the ground to lead host Ward Melville (8-1) in Suffolk I. Tony Gorsky had an interception returned for a TD and a rushing TD. Joe Benedetto had a 15-yard receiving TD and added 12 carries for 54 yards and a rushing TD. Cris Peralta had 2 rushing TDs for Brentwood (4-5).

box.title: Sachem North vs Ward Melville
box.highlights:
Ward Melville 42, Sachem North 7: Joe Karpowicz caught three passes for 104 yards and two touchdowns and Hudson Philbrick completed 12 of 15 passes for 295 yards and three TDs to lead host No. 2 Ward Melville over No. 3 Sachem North in the Suffolk Division I semifinals. Joe Benedetto had 15 carries for 77 yards and three touchdowns.  Austin Sicoli led the Patriots' defense with seven tackles. Ward Melville (9-1) will face the winner of No. 1 Floyd/No. 4 Longwood in the final at 7:30 p.m. on Friday at Stony Brook University. 
Luke LaRocca threw for 117 yards, including a 48-yard TD pass to Jon Giraulo for Sachem North, which finished 7-3.

box.title: Ward Melville vs Floyd
box.highlights: No. 2 Ward Melville defeats No. 1 Floyd for the Suffolk Division I title. Ward Melville (10-1) will face Massapequa in the LIC at noon on Friday at Hofstra.

box.title: Ward Melville vs Massapequa
box.highlights: Massapequa (12-0) defeats Ward Melville (10-2) to claim its third straight Long Island Class I title.
